data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate's gross claims outstanding at the opening of 2018 (i.e. closing at 31-Dec-2017) is reported in the technical provisions (claims outstanding). The report does not present a clearly labelled GROSS quantitative movement for prior years that could be unambiguously extracted; therefore prior-year development (gross) is not available from the provided pages. Premiums written are shown for 2018 and split by the Brit Global Specialty Direct and Brit Global Specialty Reinsurance divisions.
data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Statement of Financial Position (Technical provisions - Claims outstanding) prior-year column (31-Dec-2017). Prior year movement (gross) not found in a clearly labelled 'movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' note; claims development triangle and movement notes are present in the report images but the gross PYD figure could not be unambiguously extracted from the provided images. Gross premium split taken from divisional table ('Brit Global Specialty Direct' and 'Brit Global Specialty Reinsurance') on page 37; amounts are approximate based on image reading. Where explicit gross PYD was not found, prior_year_development_gbp_m is null.
